messages:
Nina (CS): Heads up — Velora renewal window opens in ~90 days. Procurement just pinged that their signer is delegated to a finance lead and they need a PO routing path. Also spotted two onboarding risks: Okta SSO claim mapping and delayed seat provisioning if we wait for final signature.
Raj (AM): Thanks, Nina. Do we have a requested contract term change from them or pricing asks?
Nina (CS): They asked for a 12→9 month shortened term option and wanted to hold pricing until legal confirms delegated signer is acceptable. They also asked if early commit gets a modest discount.
Sam (Finance): What net terms are they expecting? PO vs credit card? If they need PO we need vendor code and invoice entity confirmed.
Raj (AM): Velora prefers PO + Net30. They can switch to CC for faster closing but procurement prefers PO.
Elena (Legal): On delegated signers — we need the delegated signer name, title, and an internal authorization doc. If they can share a delegation letter (pdf) we can proceed with docusign recipient rules. Otherwise we need exec signature.
Maya (Onboarding): For SSO: their Okta engineer flagged attribute mapping differences. If signature drags past kickoff we risk a 2-week delay for seat provisioning and training. We should lock an enablement date contingent on signature.
Nina (CS): Agreed. Proposed path: 1) Ask Velora for delegation letter + PO number; 2) Send DocuSign envelope with recipient set to delegated finance contact; 3) Schedule enablement week tentatively for 2 weeks after signature; 4) Offer 5% early-commit discount if they sign within 30 days. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Sam (Finance): 5% early-commit OK but need to flag to revenue ops — price book change. Also need PO format. Example PO we accept: 
```
PO: VEL-PO-2026-0421
Amount: $120,000
Entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
```
Raj (AM): I'll confirm the exact figure with Velora. They're considering seat add-on mid-term which affects billing cadence.
Elena (Legal): If we accept delegated signer, clause we add: "Delegated signer shall provide an authorization letter from an officer of the entity; Redwood may verify via the customer's procurement system." I can draft a short acknowledgement to attach.
Nina (CS): Perfect. Can you draft and share by EOD? I'll ping the customer for the delegation PDF and PO.
Raj (AM): I'll ask for PO number and delegation PDF in the next email. If they push back on delegation we escalate to their GC.
esign-bot: DocuSign envelope created (env_0a1b2c). Recipient: Velora Finance (delegated). Status: awaiting signature. Link: https://docusign.example/env/env_0a1b2c
Raj (AM): Link sent to Velora procurement.
Maya (Onboarding): Tentative enablement slots: May 6-8 or May 13-15. I'll block both and convert when signature clears.
Sam (Finance): Noted. Also need vendor code — Velora to provide vendor code for PO routing. Without vendor code, invoice will be delayed.
Nina (CS): Action items: 
- Raj: request delegation PDF + PO number + vendor code (due 2 business days)
- Elena: draft delegated-signer acknowledgement (due EOD)
- Sam: prepare price-book change request for 5% early-commit (due 3 business days)
- Maya: block tentative enablement slots and create checklist for SSO attribute mapping (due 2 business days)
Raj (AM): Copying Velora thread after this. Will update here with their PO and delegation letter.
Elena (Legal): Quick Q — do we require notarization for their jurisdiction? If yes we'll note it.
Nina (CS): Notarization not typical for corporate procurement docs, but ask them if procurement requires it.
Raj (AM): Velora responded — they provided PO number: VEL-PO-2026-0421 and said delegated signer is "Priya Rao, Finance Director". Attached delegation PDF coming in next reply.
Nina (CS): Great, once delegation PDF is attached we can route the DocuSign.
esign-bot: DocuSign envelope env_0a1b2c updated — recipient added: Priya Rao <priya@velora.com>. Status: sent.
Raj (AM): Priya signed the envelope. DocuSign status: completed.
esign-bot: DocuSign envelope env_0a1b2c status: completed. Signed copy: https://docusign.example/signed/env_0a1b2c.pdf
Sam (Finance): Received signed copy. I'll queue invoice to be issued to vendor code VEL-VC-889 and Net30 terms.
Maya (Onboarding): With signature complete I'm locking enablement for May 6-8. Sending calendar invites and pre-kickoff checklist.
Nina (CS): Thanks team — we're green. I'll close this renewal thread after we confirm the final invoice send date. :white_check_mark:
